values.en: A named-binder presentation writes each λ-binder and its bound occurrences using a variable name. The names are presentation data: consistently renaming a binder by α-conversion preserves the binding structure.
values.zh-CN: 绑定子命名表示用变量名书写每个 λ-绑定子及其约束的出现。名称属于表示层数据；通过 α-转换一致地重命名绑定子不会改变绑定结构。
